Built on trust

How we keep every search safe

Property decisions are big decisions. We put checks in place so you can focus on finding the right home.

The "Verified" badge means identity documents were reviewed by our team. It is not a legal check of property title — always verify ownership documents before paying.

Manual listing review

Photos, prices and details are checked before a listing is published, and again when key details change.

Verified owners & brokers

Partners can submit ID and business documents, stored privately and seen only by our verification team.

Privacy controls

Owners decide who sees their phone number, and exact addresses stay hidden unless they choose to share them.

Report & act fast

Anything suspicious can be reported in one tap. Our team reviews every report and removes policy violations.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Everything you need to know about searching, listing and staying safe.

All questions

Yes. Tenants and buyers can search, save favourites, send enquiries and request visits for free.

Register as a property owner or broker, then use 'List property' in your dashboard. The step-by-step form collects details, photos and pricing. Every listing is reviewed by our team before it goes live.

It means our team has reviewed the identity (and, for brokers, business) documents submitted by the owner or broker. It is not a legal verification of property title. Always check ownership documents yourself, or with a lawyer, before paying any money.

Owners and brokers choose who can see their phone number: everyone, signed-in users only, or nobody (enquiries through the website only). Exact street addresses are shown only when the owner allows it.

Each plan has a listing duration (for example 30 days on the Free plan). You will get a reminder before your listing expires and can renew it from your dashboard.

Paid plans are purchased securely through Razorpay using UPI, cards or net banking. Your plan is activated only after the payment is verified on our server. We never store your card details.
